balls.text: another wide down leg side this time, in the blockhole from Arshdeep but his lines are all over the shop, Rashid tries to glance from his crease but misses, Shreyas is reviewing the wide call again, hopefully the TV umpire will reach his decision a bit quicker than the last time ... good review, ultra edge shows the ball made contact with the pad, so that's finally the end of the over, and the innings.
phew, what a long long over this is, Arshdeep tries to bowl the wide yorker and errs on the too wide side
swung behind square for a single
Tewatia moves outside leg stump to make room and Arshdeep follows him with a yorker that seems to swing late into him and cramp the batter for room, he fails to make proper contact
fired it full and fast but the line is down leg side, Rashid misses the glance and the keeper collects, Prabhsimran throws at the stumps and concedes a bye
fired in full and wide, Rashid has a wild slash at the free hit but it's too wide, the free hit remains for the next ball

caught at short third, but it's been called a no-ball for the delivery being the third bouncer of the over! Tewatia tried to go up and over but there was no pace to work with at all and he hit it tamely to the fielder
caught at short third, but it's been called a no-ball for the delivery being the third bouncer of the over!
dug into the pitch short of a length again, and once again Tewatia struggles with it, getting hit on the body as he tries to move towards the off to hit on the leg side
another slower short one, but it's a legal delivery and Tewatia can't connect with his swipe, he's not happy at it not being called a wide
the slower bouncer but it's been called wide again

caught on the deep square leg boundary! Pace-on this time and the length was fuller from around the wicket, Shahrukh planted his front foot and swung hard across the line, Arshdeep ran around to his right on the boundary's edge and judged the catch superbly
pace off once more, so effective that strategy has been against GT's batters ... short of a length and wide outside off, Tewatia slaps it towards deep cover

the slower short ball and Tewatia lets it go, the umpire calls wide for height but Prabhsimran convinces Shreyas to review it, insisting it wasn't over the batter's head, the third umpire will check it ... it's taking a while but the umpire was right in the end. That took ages.
pace off for another short of a length ball, Tewatia moves across his crease and pulls, Shashank Singh dives after covering good ground to his right from fine leg and relays the throw to Connolly
fuller length around off, driven through covers wide of the fielder in the deep
pace off again, short of a length and close to off stump, Tewatia is cramped for room and beaten as he swats at it

in the air and straight to Arshdeep at deep point! Two wickets for Vyshak. He dug it in short and took pace off the ball, Sundar waited , got under the ball and cut it in the air, simply did not get enough power on the shot
superb fielding from the bowler, dives to his right to cut off a firm drive from Shahrukh, that was in the blockhole to finish his spell
no timing on that, flays at a low full toss and slices it towards mid on
makes contact this time for a boundary after nearly three overs, too full and on the pads, poor line with fine leg in the circle and Sundar beats the fielder with the leg glance
it's not happening for Sundar, he shapes to try and hit a short ball but then bails out of the shot and plays a half-swipe as it angles across him and through to the keeper
in the blockhole just outside off stump, pace-on, Sundar tries to dig it out but gets beaten
fired wide outside the off stump from over the wicket, too wide
low full toss, no room for the batter to work with, driven along the ground to long on
pace-off, short of a length and angling away from the left-hander from around the wicket, Sundar reaches for it and chips the ball in the air towards deep cover
Sundar has a big swing at a pace-on delivery from around the wicket, he missed and  the ball passed between his legs
slower ball from over the stumps on a wicket to wicket line, nudged off the pads in front of square leg
low full toss on a wicket to wicket line, pushed past the bowler to long off, it's all gone quiet for GT
nudged off the back foot into the leg side for one more, shorter length and slower that was
good length from over the wicket, Sundar swings it through midwicket but hasn't timed it well
full toss to finish his spell, Sundar drives to long on for just the single, top start to the season for Yuzi Chahal
steps out and plays the ball on the off side, has to reach for it a bit

caught on the long on boundary, Bartlett has timed his jump perfectly! Buttler stepped out of his crease to try and get under the ball and loft over the long-on boundary, he almost managed to succeed, but Bartlett positioned himself on the edge on the boundary and jumped up to take the catch over his head, Buttler can't quite believe it
bowled flat and at the pads with some turn, no room for Buttler, played back to the bolwer
bowled flat and quick, angling into the right-hander, Buttler reverse-swats but can't beat point
fired wide of the left-hander from over the wicket, played into the off side
short of a length angling into Sundar who stays in his crease and swats it to deep midwicket
three in a row! But this time the length is too short and the ball bounces over Sundar, the umpire calls it wide for height
another dot as Sundar fails to connect, he lets another short one go outside off
the slower short one outside off, Sundar moves towards the line of the ball and then drops his wrists to let it pass
fuller length with width to free his arms, Sundar stays deep in his crease and drills the ball flat and wide of the fielder at mid off
played through the covers and just wide enough of the fielder in the deep to come back for the second
slower ball one again, short of a length outside off, Buttler hangs back and hits it with a flat bat through cover point

Jansen again, and this time Vyshak has his man! Fuller length, straighter line, and Phillips mis-timed the lofted shot straight to long off. It looked like Vyshak ran his fingers down the side of the ball during his release to take a bit of pace off the ball
pace off once more, with width outside off, Phillips goes back and cuts hard and absolutely races back for another two
smashed down the ground again and this time Jansen has an easier stop to make, running to his right
full toss, Phillips smashes it extremely hard past the bowler and it looks like it's heading for four until Jansen makes the dive on the long off boundary and saves two runs
short ball with plenty of width outside off, that was the slower one, Buttler waited and slashed to deep point
full and wide outside off from Vyshak, who replaces Chahal, driven through the covers
fired into the blockhole, Buttler digs it out on the leg side for a single
good length and straight, played back to the bowler
plays the flick along the ground to deep midwicket
short ball and smashed, nothing fancy here, just an old fashioned pull hit extremely hard and far over the deep midwicket boundary, that was way too short from Bartlett
shapes to scoop way too early, Bartlett pitches short of a length outside off and away from the scooping arc of Buttler who fails to make contact
fullish length from over the wicket angling into the right-hander, Phillips pushes to wide long on
nudged off the pads for a single

catch it paaji, screams Chahal but it's just wide of Shreyas' reach at extra cover as he dives full length to his right ... the line was wide outside off and Phillips reached out for it and slapped it hard, flat and just safe
the first reverse sweep from anyone today and Buttler plays it through point
whoops, that stopped on Buttler and he nearly chipped it back to the bowler
bowled flatter and straighter, Phillips nudges on the leg side

that's high, and that's gone far enough to clear the straight boundary! Chahal tossed that up and angled it into the right-hander, Phillips made a bit of room and hit through the line with a full extension of his arms, Chahal thought he had his man at long on but it wasn't to be
he goes back over the wicket to Buttler and pitches on a fuller length on leg stump, Buttler stays in his crease and flicks through midwicket
no room to work with this time, angling at Phillips' body from around the wicket, dabbed into the covers for a single
fuller and straighter, and perhaps another slower ball, Buttler stays in his crease and drives to long off
angled into Phillips from around the wicket, shorter length, the batter swivels and pulls to deep backward square
slower ball on a good length, pitching outside leg and angling at Buttler's front pad, driven on the up to long on
low full toss outside off stump, Phillips reaches for it and opens the face to steer the ball to deep third
skiddy ball on off and middle, forcing the defence from Buttler on the front foot
bowled fuller on off stump, driven down to long off for a single
reaches on the front foot for a flighted ball and defends back towards the bowler

Gill has not looked fluent against Chahal and he holes out in the deep! Chahal gave that ball air on middle stump, Gill got down on one knee and attempted the big slog sweep, he didn't hit it far enough and Connolly settled under the catch on the deep midwicket boundary
bowled full and the line is outside leg, Gill gets down low and slog sweeps to deep backward square leg
tossed up on middle, Gill steps out and towards leg to create room and loft inside out over cover for four
ooh, that's a close call for wide, Chahal tossed it up near the tram line outside off, Gill had moved a touch towards leg and was too far away from the line to play a shot
Buttler moves towards the off side and scoops the ball wide of the keeper and to the fine leg boundary to finish the over
full toss on a wicket to wicket line, Gill drives along the ground to wide long on
slower ball again, Gill mis-times the drive back to the bowler

fuller, straighter and faster ... Buttler stays in his crease and dabs into the covers, Gill takes off for a quick single and Buttler has to respond in a hurry, the throw from Stoinis misses at the bowler's end or else Buttler might have been short
Buttler charges and waits for the slower one before playing the pull shot but still gets beaten on the bottom edge by the change of pace
slower ball angling into the right-hander from over the wicket, played back to the bowler
bowled quick through the air on a wicket to wicket line, Gill stays in his crease and punches to long off
wider line outside off, Gill steps out and reaches for the ball to slap it to wide long off
clears his front foot and has a swipe across the line, hits it to deep square leg but without great timing
tries to slog sweep - not a shot you see often from Gill - but does not make contact, the ball hits his pad and goes on the leg side
Gill leans forward and nudges towards mid-on, makes a loud call of NO for the quick single
bowled flat on a wicket to wicket line, Buttler goes back and punches to long off
steps out of his crease again and this time plays that short-arm pull along the ground to deep midwicket
Gill steps forward and plays into the covers, shorter length again and Gill did not time that well, ended up flat-batting it
shorter length but the ball does not get high enough for Buttler to connect with the pull shot, gets a bottom edge that goes off his body on the off side

first six of the game and that's pinged back into the field of play off the sightscreen! Vyshak tried to bowl a slower one but his length was too full and Buttler simply waited and slammed it back over the bowler's head
straighter line, short of a length, played off the hips in front of square leg for another single
short of a length outside off, Buttler punches off the back foot through point
fires in the yorker that Buttler digs out in a hurry, gets an inside edge on to his shoe and the ball drops on the off side and they run a quick single to end the powerplay
another slower one, Buttler drives with hard hands but mis-times it to mid on
Wadhera dives on the backward point boundary but he can't cut off that cut shot from Buttler ... the length was short and there was plenty of room for Buttler to free his arms
full and straight from Jansen, pace-on that one was, Buttler plays it back to the bowler
ya, ya, ya, calls Gill after dabbing the ball towards mid-off  .. he had made room by moving outside leg but had to check his shot in the end
slower ball on leg stump, Buttler waits in his crease and nudges off his pads into the leg side
he goes over the offside this time and does so successfully! Steps out of his crease and a little towards the leg side to make room and carve a shorter ball over point and to the boundary
not short enough to pull, and certainly not when you're on the front foot like Gill was with that trademark short-arm jab aimed at midwicket, he gets beaten on the bottom edge
moves across in his crease and flicks a fuller and straighter ball through midwicket
shot! The length is shorter and the line wider, Buttler reaches away from his body and punches through cover, hit the gap and timed it superbly
fires it in full and straight this time, nearly in the blockhole, Gill digs it out into the covers
short of a length angling into the right-hander, Gill plays it towards point
played towards point with an open face, Jansen makes a great start to IPL 2026 - a wicket and just two runs in his first over
Jansen fires it in full and straight, Buttler stays in his crease and nudges tentatively to midwicket

caught at mid-off, Jansen makes the breakthrough for PBKS. Sudharsan wanted to loft that over mid on I think, but the length was good and the line was on middle and it may have straightened a touch too, he ended up slicing it straight to Shreyas Iyer. The bat turned in his hand as he made contact with the shot.
whoops! Sudharsan bent his knees and tried to ramp a short one over the keeper and slips, but he got hit on the gloves and the ball fell short of slip
twotwotwotwo is the call as Gill flicks through midwicket, he moves back and across to play that shorter length off the back foot
good length from over the wicket but the line is too straight to the left-hander, Sudharsan nudges off his pads behind square
strays on to the pads with the last ball of the over, Gill glances behind square and they have enough time to run two before the fielder runs to his right at fine leg and collects the ball
superb timing on that shot as Gill presses forward and drives on the up, the fielder at mid-ff has to scramble to his right to cut it off
first false shot from these GT openers, Gill charges and pulls, he's cramped for room by the short one and gets a top edge over the keeper and slips for another boundary
strays down leg side, Gill misses the glance off the hips
good length on off and middle, Sudharsan stays in his crease and plays the ball through point with an open face
played off the back foot towards backward point

short ball and dispatched! Arshdeep tests Sudharsan with a short one around off stump but it does not get too high on the left-hander, Sudharsan gets on his toes and pulls it to the midwicket boundary

too full, and too easy for Gill who leans forward and across in his crease and clips it wide of the diving fielder at mid-on, glorious timing and these two seem to have picked up right where they left off last season
short of a length on a wicket to wicket line, Sudharsan works the ball off his pads in front of square leg
shorter length from Bartlett outside off stump, Gill stays back this time and steers the ball towards point
down the track once again to take the ball on the full length and this time he lofts clean over the bowler's head for another boundary

steps out of a crease to a fullish ball and drives it along the ground and wide of the fielder at mid on to pick up his first boundary of the season ... converted it into a fuller length with his footwork
No, no, calls Gill after pressing forward and pushing the ball close on the leg side ... Bartlett takes a tumble on the itch during his follow through
dabbed into the covers for a quick single
good length around off and just outside, Sudharsan stays in his crease and opens the face late, bringing his bat down low to guide the ball behind point
tighter line on middle on a good length, nudged from the crease towards midwicket

too straight from Arshdeep, strays on to the pads, giving Sudharsan an easy one to glance off his pads down to the fine leg boundary, this one came back in to the left-hander while the previous one moved away
wide outside off, too wide, Sudharsan shapes to have a flay at it and then stops and lets the ball pass through to Prabhsimran behind the stumps
short of a length again on Gill's hips, he gets going with a nudge behind square on the leg side
short of a length pitching around off with some shape away from the left-hander, Sudharsan hangs back in his crease and dabs the ball through backward point

Cooper Connolly is a star on IPL debut, seeing PBKS home in a tricky chase, when his team-mates were losing their heads all around him! He scores the winning runs by hanging back in his crease and cutting a flat and quick ball from Sundar to the cover boundary, those fast hands of his have the final say in this topsy-turvy contest.
in the blockhole, Connolly digs it out to long on to keep strike with PBKS two runs away from victory
short ball, Bartlett pulls, to the fielder at deep midwicket on the first bounce
low full toss, nearly the yorker, Connolly stays steady and digs it out on the off side for a single
the slower short ball, Connolly waits on it and then swivels and pulls, in the air but just wide of the fielder at short fine and down to the boundary, the 22-year old is seeing this home for PBKS!
pushed into the covers where Rabada fumbles and allows the single

is that the game?! Bartlett goes big, very big, smashing Prasidh's pace-on short ball over the deep midwicket boundary ... simply cleared his front foot outside leg, opened up those broad shoulders and went boom! They can't find the ball ...
full and straight again, angling into the right-hander, played from the crease through square leg ... Ashok Sharma has bowled a superb third over
fuller length and straighter, Bartlett nudges gently off the pads towards midwicket and they are racing back for the second

spooned to cover! First IPL wicket for Ashok Sharma and it's a big one at a crucial stage of the game. He's delivered a back of the hand slower ball at 109 kph, Jansen was into the shot too early and hit it straight to Shubman in the circle, he had to move a bit to his right to take the catch
what a good over so far from the debutant, Jansen plays it back to the bowler, that was good length and on a wicket to wicket line
tries to bowl the wide yorker but errs on the too wide side of the line
short of a length and wide outside off, Jansen reaches for it and tries to cut but gets beaten
chipped in the air towards long off, it was the slower one and Connolly tried to hit it too hard, ended up mis-timing it

short and slow outside off, Jansen had moved outside leg and was too far away from the ball in the end to play a shot, the umpire has called it wide! Gill reviews immediately. That's not a wide and the umpire has to reverse his decision
in the blockhole again from around the wicket, angling the ball into the left-hander, Connolley tries to whip through the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pad
in the blockhole from around the wicket, Connolly digs it out to cover
full and straight from Prasidh, Jansen moves his front foot towards the leg side and drives the ball fluently to long off
too wide outside off, Jansen lets it go
Jansen now! Stands his ground as the short ball comes at him and slams it over the wide long-on boundary, you got to get it much higher than that to trouble Marco
played back to the bowler

was about to say that Rabada has come back strong after the boundary first ball, but he ends the over with a short one that Connolly swivels and pulls over the deep square leg boundary, used the angle into him from around the wicket and made great contact, Rabada ran his fingers down the side of the ball but it sat up for Connolly
banged in short, well directed from Rabada, Connolly ducks out of the way
played off the back foot towards deep point for a single, he moved outside leg to create room against the angle into him from over the wicket
fuller ball from over the wicket, driven on the up to mid off
fuller length from around the wicket, the batter stays in his crease and drives to sweeper cover
pace-on, width outside off, Connolly hangs back and flashes with those fast hands, dispatching the ball to the backward point boundary to bring up a half-century on IPL debut ...
good length from around the wicket, not giving the left-hander room, Connolly goes back and cuts to deep point
banged in short from around the wicket, that's bounced over his head so it's a wide
short of a length outside off, cut off the back foot through point for a single

what on earth is happening, Punjab! Finding fielders with laser-guided precision! Short of a length outside off stump, Stoinis leans back and ramps, ramps it straight to the fielder at deep third, Rashid Khan barely had to move for the catch
good length from over the wicket, homing into off and middle, Stoinis gets behind the line and defends

caught behind! PBKS losing the plot here, extra bounce does the trick for Prasidh. He banged the ball in short of a length in the mid-130s outside off, Shashank tried to run the ball to deep third and got an edge through to Buttler ... the players are taking a timeout break.
fullish length angling into the right-hander, leans across and flicks to midwicket
bowled flat and straight, the batter moves back and across and works the ball through midwicket
angled into the batter from around the wicket, worked off the pads in front of square leg
moves forward and across to work the ball through the leg side but misses and is hit on the pad
moves forward and across to nudge the ball between mid on and midwicket
nudged off the pads to get going, the new batter is Shashank Singh

this is a much simpler chance for the fielder at cover ...Sudharsan's opening partner Gill is the catcher! Sundar dropped it short, Wadhera came well out of his crease and slapped it straight at the GT captain
tough chance at cover! Sai Sudharsan jumped up and to his left but could not hold on to a stinger above his head ... Connolly drilled that full ball extremely hard, picking it up on the half volley
fuller length aimed at the pads, leans towards the off side and dabs to midwicket
jumps back this time and chops the short of a length delivery coming in at him behind point for a single
short of a length again from around the wicket, cramped for room, Wadhera stays in his crease and plays towards point
short of a length from around the wicket, angling into the left-hander, he moves back and across and dabs on the leg side

and strikes first ball! Maybe that blow on the hand played a role in this dismissal because Shreyas has simply clipped a friendly half-volley off his pads straight to deep midwicket, he can't quite believe it either
bowled flat and quick outside off from around the wicket, driven off the back foot behind point for two more

oh dear, Connolly has smashed the ball straight at his captain and hurt him. Out comes the physio immediately with the ice pack for the wrist. The ball was flat and quick outside off, Connolly went back and pulled the ball hard and flat and way too fast for Shreyas to get out of the way, the ball smashed into his right glove and he's in a lot of pain here. He's getting the magic spray treatment and an ice pack. Will he continue batting? PBKS are so comfortably placed in this chase that he could go to the dressing room and recuperate ... he's going to stay in the middle.
cut hard off the back foot behind point
the googly, Connolly gets an inside edge through midwicket
short again, and Connolly goes airborne! He uses his fast hands to pounce on the length and pulls the ball far over the deep midwicket boundary ... only 81 metres this time
short ball, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
shot! Stands on his times to lace a pack-foot punch behind point, giving the fielder on the boundary some work to do, Phillips gets there quickly
played off the back foot towards mid off, short of a length again
moves the line outside off, Shreyas tries to hit the short of a length ball a bit too hard and mis-times it
and again! This time the ball does not get high enough to trouble Shreyas, he moves inside the line, swivels and hammers the pull over the long leg boundary again
banged in short and Shreyas responds with a swivel and a hook, making good enough contact to send the ball over the long leg boundary, didn't look 100% convincing but it will go
short of a length and straight, defended on the back foot
bowled quick and straight, the pitch seems to be skidding now, with the drizzle falling on it, Connolly is a bit rushed as he defends on the off side
presses forward and pushes, gets a bit of an inside edge through midwicket
gets off the mark with a fluent  cut off the front foot to deep point

hit hard and flat and straight to Prasidh Krishna on the long on boundary! Prabhsimran gave Rashid the charge but could not get under the ball enough to get the proper elevation needed to clear the boundary
worked through the leg side for a single
bowled flat and straight, cut off the back foot through point
moves outside leg to make room and plays the ball wide of the bowler on the off side, Sundar moves quickly to his right and fields sharply
driven off the front foot through cover point
goes back and works the ball off the pads towards wide long on
played back to the bowler
pushed towards mid off for a single
too short and Prabhsimran moves towards the off side, gets down on one knee and slams the ball high and far over the deep midwicket boundary with a powerful slog sweep
played off the pads behind square for a single
shorter length and wide outside off, Rashid is lucky to get away with that, Prabhsimran cut it straight to the fielder
mis-timed back to the bowler on the front foot
fuller, flatter on the pads, pushed off the front foot towards mid on

my word, that's in the second tier! Rashid dragged the ball short from around the wicket, a rank half-tracker, and Connolly stand sin his crease and hammers the ball so high and extremely far ... 103 metres!
misses the whip off the pads, the ball goes to the fielder at short fine
bowled fuller and faster outside off, driven to backward point
that's in the stands beyond long on! This time Prabhsimran was ready for the one floated outside off stump, he moved towards it and freed his arms powerfully, hitting it several rows into the stands
worked off the back foot through midwicket
bowled slowly wide outside off, cut off the back foot through point
bottom edged into the pitch as he tried to cut that on the off side
punched off the back foot through the covers
cut off the back foot to point to complete the powerplay ... PBKS on track in the chase as the players take a time out.
huge appeal for lbw and the umpire raises the finger after a while, Prabhsimran reviews immediately, he thinks he's hit the ball as he attempted the sweep. He knows he's hit. Bottom edge. Not out.
goes back and cuts a quicker ball to short third
slogged down to long on for a single
he's smashed that back over Rashid's head! Quicker pace from Rashid and Connolly simply brought his hands down quickly and hit through the line
hits the pad with a flat ball on leg stump, Connolly goes back to work the ball on the leg side
backs away outside leg stump to create room and cuts a short of a length ball hard and flat over point, PBKS are flying now
hits the ball through the leg side for a single, slower one and Connolly swung across the line

those fast hands from Connolly again! 143 kph but the line is too wide outside off from around the wicket, Connolly lifts his bat high and brings it down in a flash, carving the ball over the point boundary
full and wide down leg side, too wide for Connolly to connect with his swing
bottom edged a short of a length ball down on the off side

tough caught and bowled chance! Banged in short and fast, hurrying Connolly for time on the pull, he hit it hard and back to the bowler, Sharma reached down low with his left hand and got fingers to it but could not hold on to the chance
good length on an off and middle stump line from over the wicket, played from the crease through midwicket

stand and smash! No fancy footwork this time, he plants his front foot forward and lofts a full, pace-off ball far over wide long-off ... three sixes in that over for PBKS, as many as GT had in their whole innings.
around the wicket to the left-hander, Connolly jumps towards the off side to try and scoop over the keeper, pace off from Rabada and the ball goes between the batter and close to off stump
fuller length around off stump, dabbed off the back foot to backward point again, this time the sprint the single
punched off the back foot to backward point
too short, too wide, too fast ... Prabhsimran uses the pace and width to get under the ball and slash hard, sending the ball flying over the deep third boundary

full ball and it's disappeared as quickly as it's come! Prabhsimran clears his front foot towards the leg side and gives himself room to swing those powerful arms, hitting it flat and hard over the deep midwicket boundary
no stopping this one, Connolly has room to free his arms because the length is a bit short and this time he times the pull well, piercing the gap between midwicket and mid-on

short of a length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Connolly has a swipe across the line and just manages to clear mid-on, Rabada gives chase and dives full length to pull the ball in from the boundary
short of a length outside off, Prabhsimran drops it close on the off side and sets off for the single
strays on to the pads and Siraj is lucky to get away with that one, fine leg was in the circle and Prabhsimran glanced it off the pads straight to the fielder
fast hands, really fast hands from Connolly, he did not have much room to work with there but managed to slash the length ball from close to off stump through covers
short of a length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Connolly has a swipe and misses
